environment: Local Next.js development server at 127.0.0.1:3100, single-process PGlite. HTTP curl clients orchestrated concurrently by the coding tool. No browser was launched.
scope: 50 synthetic authenticated learners in one organization, one 120-second question, host ended the room after all answers. This is a local concurrency smoke test, not a production capacity benchmark.
limitations: One question and one cohort; repeated soak tests and hosted PostgreSQL load tests remain required.
Polling transport, not push transport. Network delay affects speed points.
Browser rendering and accessibility review are assigned to the user.
